title.zh: 卷六十八 表第八 方鎮五
title.raw: 卷六十八 表第八 方鎮五 Volume 68 Tables 8: Military Commanderies 5

sentences.zh: 表第八 方鎮表五

translations.literal: Table 8, Military Commanderies Table 5.
translations.idiomatic: Table 8: Military Commanderies, Part Five.

sentences.zh: 西元 東川 淮南 江東 浙東 福建 洪吉 鄂岳沔

translations.literal: Western calendar [CE]. Dongchuan. Huainan. Jiangdong. Zhedong. Fujian. Hong-Ji. E-Yue-Mian.
translations.idiomatic: CE dates. Columns: Dongchuan; Huainan; Jiangdong; Zhedong; Fujian; Hong–Ji; E–Yue–Mian.

sentences.zh: 710 景雲元年

translations.literal: 710, first year of the Jingyun era.
translations.idiomatic: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign.

sentences.zh: 712 先天元年

translations.literal: 712, first year of the Xiantian era.
translations.idiomatic: 712 CE, first year of the Xiantian reign.

sentences.zh: 713 開元元年

translations.literal: 713, first year of the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 713 CE, first year of the Kaiyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 758 乾元元年 置浙江西道節度兼江寧軍使，領昇、潤、宣、歙、饒、江、蘇、常、杭、湖十州，治昇州，尋徙治蘇州，未幾，罷領宣、歙、饒三州，副使兼餘杭軍使，治杭州。

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era. The Zhejiang West circuit commissioner concurrently holding the Jiangning Army commissioner post was established, holding Sheng, Run, Xuan, She, Rao, Jiang, Su, Chang, Hang, and Hu prefectures—ten in all—with seat at Sheng Prefecture; soon the seat was moved to Su Prefecture; before long, jurisdiction over Xuan, She, and Rao prefectures was discontinued; the deputy commissioner concurrently held the Yuhang Army commissioner post, with seat at Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 758, the first year of Qianyuan, a Zhejiang West circuit commissioner was created who also served as Jiangning Army commissioner, commanding ten prefectures—Sheng, Run, Xuan, She, Rao, Jiang, Su, Chang, Hang, and Hu—from his seat at Sheng Prefecture. The seat was soon moved to Su Prefecture; before long Xuan, She, and Rao were removed from his command, while the deputy commissioner took the Yuhang Army commissioner post at Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置浙江東道節度使，領越、睦、衢、婺、臺、明、處、溫八州，治越州。

translations.literal: A Zhejiang East circuit military commissioner was established, holding Yue, Mu, Qu, Wu, Tai, Ming, Chu, and Wen prefectures—eight in all—with seat at Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhejiang East circuit military commissioner was appointed, commanding eight prefectures—Yue, Mu, Qu, Wu, Tai, Ming, Chu, and Wen—from his seat at Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改福建經略使為都防禦使兼寧海軍使。

translations.literal: The Fujian frontier commissioner was changed to chief defense commissioner concurrently holding the Ninghai Army commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian frontier commissioner was redesignated chief defense commissioner, concurrently serving as Ninghai Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置洪吉都防禦團練觀察處置使兼莫傜軍使，領洪、吉、虔、撫、袁五州，治洪州。

translations.literal: The Hong-Ji chief defense, training, observation, and disposal commissioner concurrently holding the Mo Yao Army commissioner post was established, holding Hong, Ji, Qian, Fu, and Yuan prefectures—five in all—with seat at Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Hong–Ji chief defense, training, observation, and disposal commissioner was installed who also served as Mo Yao Army commissioner, commanding Hong, Ji, Qian, Fu, and Yuan from his seat at Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置宣歙饒觀察使，治宣州。

translations.literal: The Xuan-She-Rao observation commissioner was established, with seat at Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An Xuan–She–Rao observation commissioner was appointed, headquartered at Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 759 二年 劍南東川增領昌、渝、合三州。

translations.literal: 759, second year. Jiannan East Chuan added Chang, Yu, and He prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 759, the second year of Qianyuan, Jiannan East Chuan gained jurisdiction over Chang, Yu, and He prefectures.

sentences.zh: 沔州隸鄂岳節度，壽州隸淮西節度。

translations.literal: Mian Prefecture was placed under the E-Yue circuit; Shou Prefecture under the Huaixi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Mian Prefecture was assigned to the E–Yue circuit, and Shou Prefecture to the Huaixi circuit.

sentences.zh: 廢浙江西道節度使，置觀察處置都團練守捉及本道營田使，更領丹陽軍使，治蘇州，復領宣、歙、饒三州。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang West circuit military commissioner was abolished; an observation, disposal, chief training, garrison, and the circuit's farm commissioner was established, additionally taking charge of the Danyang Army commissioner post, with seat at Su Prefecture; Xuan, She, and Rao prefectures were again placed under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang West circuit military commissioner was abolished and replaced by an observation, disposal, chief training, and garrison commissioner who also supervised the circuit's farming operations and held the Danyang Army commissioner post at Su Prefecture; Xuan, She, and Rao were restored to his command.

sentences.zh: 廢宣歙饒觀察使。

translations.literal: The Xuan-She-Rao observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuan–She–Rao observation commissioner was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 置鄂、岳、沔三州都團練守捉使，治鄂州。

translations.literal: A chief training and garrison commissioner for E, Yue, and Mian prefectures was established, with seat at E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A chief training and garrison commissioner for E, Yue, and Mian prefectures was installed, headquartered at E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 760 上元元年 升福建都防禦使為節度使。

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era. The Fujian chief defense commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 760, the first year of Shangyuan, the Fujian chief defense commissioner was raised to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 洪吉觀察使增領信州。

translations.literal: The Hong-Ji observation commissioner added Xin Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Hong–Ji observation commissioner gained jurisdiction over Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 岳州隸荊南節度。

translations.literal: Yue Prefecture was placed under the Jingnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Prefecture was transferred to the Jingnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 762 寶應元年

translations.literal: 762, first year of the Baoying era.
translations.idiomatic: 762 CE, first year of the Baoying reign.

sentences.zh: 763 廣德元年

translations.literal: 763, first year of the Guangde era.
translations.idiomatic: 763 CE, first year of the Guangde reign.

sentences.zh: 升壽州團練使為都團練觀察使，領壽、濠、廬三州，治壽州。

translations.literal: The Shou Prefecture training commissioner was promoted to chief training and observation commissioner, holding Shou, Hao, and Lu prefectures—three in all—with seat at Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shou Prefecture training commissioner was raised to chief training and observation commissioner, commanding Shou, Hao, and Lu from his seat at Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 785 貞元元年 廢江南西道節度使，復置都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: 785, first year of the Zhenyuan era. The Jiangnan West circuit military commissioner was abolished; a chief training and observation commissioner was again established.
translations.idiomatic: In 785, the first year of Zhenyuan, the Jiangnan West circuit military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a restored chief training and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 805 永貞元年

translations.literal: 805, first year of the Yongzhen era.
translations.idiomatic: 805 CE, first year of the Yongzhen reign.

sentences.zh: 升壽州團練使為都團練使，領壽、泗、楚三州，治泗州。

translations.literal: The Shou Prefecture training commissioner was promoted to chief training commissioner, holding Shou, Si, and Chu prefectures—three in all—with seat at Si Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shou Prefecture training commissioner was raised to chief training commissioner, commanding Shou, Si, and Chu from his seat at Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 尋廢都團練使，復為壽州團練使，以泗州隸武寧節度，楚州隸淮南節度。

translations.literal: Soon the chief training commissioner was abolished and restored to Shou Prefecture training commissioner; Si Prefecture was placed under the Wuning circuit, and Chu Prefecture under the Huainan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the chief training commissioner was abolished and the post reverted to Shou Prefecture training commissioner; Si Prefecture was assigned to the Wuning circuit, and Chu Prefecture to the Huainan circuit.

sentences.zh: 升浙江西道都團練觀察使為鎮海軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang West circuit chief training and observation commissioner was promoted to Zhenhai Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang West chief training and observation commissioner was raised to Zhenhai Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 821 長慶元年 淮南節度增領宿州。

translations.literal: 821, first year of the Changqing era. The Huainan circuit added Su Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 821, the first year of Changqing, the Huainan circuit gained jurisdiction over Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 825 寶曆元年

translations.literal: 825, first year of the Baoli era.
translations.idiomatic: 825 CE, first year of the Baoli reign.

sentences.zh: 827 大和元年

translations.literal: 827, first year of the Dahe era.
translations.idiomatic: 827 CE, first year of the Dahe reign.

sentences.zh: 836 開成元年

translations.literal: 836, first year of the Kaicheng era.
translations.idiomatic: 836 CE, first year of the Kaicheng reign.

sentences.zh: 841 會昌元年

translations.literal: 841, first year of the Huichang era.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign.

sentences.zh: 847 大中元年 復置武昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: 847, first year of the Dazhong era. The Wuchang Army military commissioner was again established.
translations.idiomatic: In 847, the first year of Dazhong, the Wuchang Army military commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 860 咸通元年

translations.literal: 860, first year of the Xiantong era.
translations.idiomatic: 860 CE, first year of the Xiantong reign.

sentences.zh: 874 乾符元年 廢鎮南軍節度，復置江南西道觀察使。

translations.literal: 874, first year of the Qianfu era. The Zhennan Army circuit was abolished; the Jiangnan West circuit observation commissioner was again established.
translations.idiomatic: In 874, the first year of Qianfu, the Zhennan Army circuit was abolished and the Jiangnan West observation commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 880 廣明元年

translations.literal: 880, first year of the Guangming era.
translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign.

sentences.zh: 881 中和元年

translations.literal: 881, first year of the Zhonghe era.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign.

sentences.zh: 885 光啟元年

translations.literal: 885, first year of the Guangqi era.
translations.idiomatic: 885 CE, first year of the Guangqi reign.

sentences.zh: 888 文德元年 龍州隸威戎節度。

translations.literal: 888, first year of the Wende era. Long Prefecture was placed under the Weirong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 888, the first year of Wende, Long Prefecture was assigned to the Weirong circuit.

sentences.zh: 置忠國軍節度使，治湖州。

translations.literal: The Zhongguo Army military commissioner was established, with seat at Hu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhongguo Army military commissioner was appointed, headquartered at Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復置武昌軍節度。

translations.literal: The Wuchang Army circuit was again established.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuchang Army circuit was restored.

sentences.zh: 889 龍紀元年 置杭州防禦使。

translations.literal: 889, first year of the Longji era. A Hangzhou defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 889, the first year of Longji, a Hangzhou defense commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 復升江南西道觀察使為鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan West circuit observation commissioner was again promoted to Zhennan Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan West observation commissioner was again raised to Zhennan Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 890 大順元年

translations.literal: 890, first year of the Dashun era.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign.

sentences.zh: 894 乾寧元年

translations.literal: 894, first year of the Qianning era.
translations.idiomatic: 894 CE, first year of the Qianning reign.

sentences.zh: 898 光化元年

translations.literal: 898, first year of the Guanghua era.
translations.idiomatic: 898 CE, first year of the Guanghua reign.

sentences.zh: 901 天復元年

translations.literal: 901, first year of the Tianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 901 CE, first year of the Tianfu reign.

sentences.zh: 本北宋作品在全世界都属于公有领域，因为作者逝世已经遠遠超过100年。

translations.literal: This Northern Song work belongs to the public domain worldwide, because the author died more than one hundred years ago by a wide margin.
translations.idiomatic: This Northern Song work is in the public domain worldwide, as the author's death lies far more than a century in the past.
